options.plan: B2B Free; upstream workforce entitlement unverified
options.region: No tenant regions selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Okta Workforce connection; manual OIDC web app plus separate SCIM app; no OIN Express or downstream bridge

conditions: Use the dedicated Okta Workforce connection with an upstream OIDC Web application, its callback/client settings and application enablement in Auth0; not a generic OIDC or SAML connection.
The B2B Free offer at https://auth0.com/pricing lists Okta connections separately from generic Enterprise Connections; system limits and both tenant entitlements still require verification.
This is one manual upstream configuration, not OIN Express Configuration, custom authorization-server access, downstream app login or tested customer compatibility.

evidence.summary: The dedicated Okta Workforce guide describes configuring an upstream OIDC Web app and enabling its Auth0 connection. OPTIONAL is a documentation proposal, not a tenant or application test.

conditions: The documented manual path uses separate OIDC and SCIM app instances with matching assignments; disable Federation Broker Mode on the OIDC app and configure connection-specific SCIM externalId mapping.
Use the bearer-token SCIM app with create, update and deactivate actions, without password provisioning; review PUT attribute mappings and token operation scopes.

Auth0 Free includes inbound SCIM, but upstream Okta provisioning entitlement and this pair's mappings are unverified; UNKNOWN does not mean unsupported or inherit OPTIONAL from the generic Auth0 draft.
Provisioning runs from Okta into Auth0, not from Auth0 into the SaaS; downstream permissions, local sessions and revocation behavior require separate enforcement and tests.

evidence.summary: Auth0 describes a manual two-app Okta provisioning setup. The guide alone does not establish both commercial entitlements or correct identity correlation in this unconfigured pair.

conditions: App assignment is not Group Push; group scopes, push rules and their relation to assignments must be configured separately, as described at https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/users-groups-profiles/usgp-group-push-main.htm.
Native Auth0 Group resources allow user members, not nested groups; group-specific access and both upstream/downstream entitlements remain unverified.
Do not infer SaaS organization membership, roles, group deletion cleanup or session enforcement from an inbound group object; no downstream bridge is selected.

evidence.summary: Auth0 documents Group operations and separate authorization/external-system integrations. This pair has no verified group entitlement or application-side enforcement.
